title.zh: Casey 博客上的 Witness Friday 帖
title.en: Witness Friday post on Casey’s blog

subtitle.en: Casey Muratori writes more about planting grass when the quality of the result really matters.
subtitle.zh: Casey Muratori 接着谈种草——当你真的很在意结果质量的时候。

blocks.en: Casey Muratori is back, with [more details about planting grass](http://mollyrocket.com/casey/stream_0015.html) when you really care about how good the results are.
blocks.zh: Casey Muratori 回来了，[更详细地讲了种草这回事](http://mollyrocket.com/casey/stream_0015.html)——当你真的很在意结果有多好的时候。

blocks.en: **Update**: And here's [another post](http://mollyrocket.com/casey/stream_0017.html), complete with a video showing in detail how the grass planting works in the actual game.
blocks.zh: **更新**：还有[另一篇文章](http://mollyrocket.com/casey/stream_0017.html)，附带一段视频，详细演示了实际游戏里种草是怎么运作的。
